# Software Factory All-in-One

> Open-source software factory (planning kit) for AI coding agents. Forever generic. MIT.
> Also called: software-factory, software factory, software-factory-all-in-one, مصنع برمجيات.
> Canonical: https://github.com/Galhoom22/software-factory-all-in-one

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what it is, value, quick start, FAQ
- [00-USAGE](00-USAGE.md): requirements-driven activation
- [01-STEPS](01-STEPS.md): idea → complete plan
- [ARCHITECTURE](ARCHITECTURE.md): which documents to load for a task
- [EXCELLENCE](EXCELLENCE.md): north star (speed × professionalism)

## Method spine

- [02-DELIVERY](02-DELIVERY.md): actor loop (no MVP delivery mode)
- [03-PROTOTYPE](03-PROTOTYPE.md): production-faithful prototype
- [04-FEATURE_SDLC](04-FEATURE_SDLC.md): feature depth in implementation repos
- [05-PROMPTS](05-PROMPTS.md): ready agent prompts
- [06-LESSONS](06-LESSONS.md): transferable lessons
- [07-judgment/](07-judgment/README.md): conditional judgment guides (SEO+GEO, payments, AI, patterns, …)
- [08-IMPLEMENTATION-DAY](08-IMPLEMENTATION-DAY.md): day pipeline + closeout
- [09-CI-CD](09-CI-CD.md): CI/CD phases for honest Done

## Libraries (on demand)

- [design-patterns/](design-patterns/README.md): GoF packs — open only via [07-judgment/design-patterns.md](07-judgment/design-patterns.md)
architecture-patterns/: On-demand cloud/distributed architecture packs (open via 07-judgment/architecture-patterns.md; SF-20)
- [technologies/](technologies/README.md): stack packs
- [agents/](agents/README.md): harness packs
- [coverage/](coverage/README.md): honest craft atlas

## Seed and contribute

- Seed: `node scripts/seed.mjs ../your-planning-repo` (see README Quick start)

## Note for Google Search

Google Search does not require this file ([AI optimization guide](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide)). It exists for systems that choose to read `llms.txt`. Human-facing truth stays in README.md and the method docs.
